description:
Reformat the screenplay draft in '/home/ga/Documents/screenplay_draft.docx' to meet industry standards. The current draft uses the wrong font, margins, and alignment. You must:

1. Select all text and change the font to 'Courier New' (or 'Liberation Mono') at 12 points.
2. Set the Page Margins: Left Margin to 1.50 inches (to allow for binding), and Top, Bottom, and Right Margins to 1.00 inch.
3. Apply the 'Heading 1' paragraph style to all Scene Headings (lines starting with 'INT.' or 'EXT.').
4. Center-align all Character Names (capitalized names like 'NARRATOR', 'OLD MAN', 'OFFICER DUPIN' appearing above dialogue).
5. Right-align all Transitions (lines like 'FADE IN:', 'CUT TO:', 'FADE OUT.').

Save the correctly formatted document as '/home/ga/Documents/screenplay_formatted.docx'. Do not overwrite the original draft.
